data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: .github/workflows/calibration-rollup.yml has the env-var guard (lines 62-64, 77-79) but the upstream mutation-testing and churn-analysis jobs that should set MUTATION_FINDINGS_COUNT and SUITE_CHURN_COUNT via $GITHUB_ENV do not exist on HEAD — env vars always default to 0. Proposed fix: add upstream jobs (or a workflow_call/needs chain) that run mutation/churn tools and inject the counts. Classification: MODERATE — multi-step but bounded; needs identifying the mutation framework + test churn script first. Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
